title: Snowglobe Cobblemon Tournament Modpack
description: A cobblemon focused modpack created for a tournament event with my friends! This pack contains cobblemon-focused content as well as a handful of extra additions and quality of life.
body:
A cobblemon focused modpack made for my friends and I's tournament event! This modpack serves as an easier way to allow people to install/update the pack without manually downloading a fresh .mrpack file. 
The pack contains multiple cobblemon addons with the goal of making the tournament as accessible and fun as possible.  Some addons include Cobblemon Unchained, which allows for chaining pokemon to increase individual values and shiny odds, Cobbleworkers which makes Cobblemon able to perform various tasks, and Cobbreeding which adds simple cobblemon breeding.  On top of this, the pack contains various smaller mods meant for decorating bases and numerous quality of life/optimization mods.
This pack was created with the goal of being lightweight as well as providing plenty of content for a shorter term playthrough with friends! :D
